biological_replicate: quadruplicate flasks for BioID, triplicate or quadruplicate for PRM

BioID-Myc or BioID-Myc-EYA4 plasmids were transfected into T150 flasks of 293Ts at 50% confluence in quadruplicate. Myc-tagged PLK1 was overexpressed in triplicate or quadruplicate for each treatment in 293 T cells.
experimental_design: Comparison of EYA4-BioID2 vs BioID2-Myc control, and PLK1 phosphorylation under EYA4 knockdown or benzarone treatment vs controls

Biotinylation of proteins after expression of Myc-BioID2-EYA4 was compared to a BioID2-Myc control using mass spectrometry with label-free quantification (LFQ). Treatments included siRNA against EYA4 or a control sequence, or incubation with benzarone (10 µM) or DMSO
factor_value: condition (Myc-BioID2-EYA4, BioID2-Myc, EYA4 siRNA, control siRNA, benzarone, DMSO)
